both_hands.description: Both hands present and valid pose; all features normalized.

left_only.description: Left hand present, right hand null; right hand features NaN.

right_only.description: Right hand present, left hand null; left hand features NaN.

no_hands.description: Both hands null, pose present; hands NaN, pose normalized.

no_pose.description: No pose present; all 144 features NaN.

left_dominant.description: 3-frame sequence where left hand moves more; left dominant and canonicalized.

shoulders_swapped.description: Shoulders inverted in space; width remains positive norm and normalized accordingly.

zero_shoulder_width.description: Zero shoulder width produces all NaNs to prevent division by zero.
